summary: Tested Flash Sales feature for Bundle Deals. All 14 backend tests passed (flash-sales endpoint, flash_active status, pricing calculations, admin CRUD for flash fields, edge cases for expired/future flash sales). Frontend UI verified: Homepage shows Flash Sale banner with live countdown timer (HRS:MIN:SEC digit boxes), flash bundle cards have red 'FLASH SALE' badge with compact timer, non-flash bundles retain gold styling. Bundle Detail Page shows red countdown bar at top and red CTA button. PDP shows 'FLASH SALE — Part of [Bundle]' banner with timer. Admin panel shows 'FLASH SALE LIVE' badge on active flash bundles, and form has Flash Sale Timer section with toggle.
critical_code_review_comments: bundle_routes.py: is_flash_active() correctly compares ISO datetime strings for start <= now <= end
bundle_routes.py: calc_bundle_pricing() correctly adds flash_extra_discount to base_discount when flash is active
bundle_routes.py: /flash-sales endpoint uses MongoDB query with $lte/$gte for datetime filtering
BundleDeals.jsx: CountdownTimer component has two variants - 'default' (digit boxes) and 'compact' (inline text)
BundleDeals.jsx: Flash bundles have red-themed UI (border-red, text-red, bg-red) throughout
BundleDeals.jsx: ProductBundleBanner shows 'FLASH SALE —' prefix when bundle.flash_active is true
AdminBundlePanel.jsx: BundleForm has Flash Sale Timer section with toggle, quick presets (2h, 6h, 12h, 24h, 48h), datetime pickers, and extra discount fields
AdminBundlePanel.jsx: Bundle list shows 'FLASH SALE LIVE' badge with animate-pulse for active flash sales
seed_data_creation: Used existing flash sale bundle: 'Accessory Essentials' (bundle_f3330d7599cf) with flash_sale_start/end set, flash_extra_discount_value=200 (flat). Non-flash bundle: 'Complete Look Bundle' (bundle_df99f00cfba2) with 15% discount.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flash Sales feature fully tested. Active flash sale on 'Accessory Essentials' bundle (ends ~6h from now). Homepage shows Flash Sale banner at top of Bundle Deals section. Flash bundles have red theme, non-flash have gold theme. Admin form has Flash Sale Timer section with quick presets (2h, 6h, 12h, 24h, 48h) and datetime pickers.

backend_flash_sales_endpoints.test: GET /api/bundles/flash-sales returns only active flash bundles (start <= now <= end)
Flash bundles have flash_active, flash_sale_start, flash_sale_end, flash_extra_discount fields
GET /api/bundles returns bundles with flash_active=true when flash sale is live
GET /api/bundles/{id} returns flash_active, flash_sale_end, flash_extra_discount fields

backend_flash_pricing.test: Flash sale adds extra discount on top of base bundle discount
Bundle pricing includes flash_extra_discount in discount_amount when flash is active

backend_admin_flash_fields.test: PUT /api/bundles/admin/{id} can set flash_sale_start, flash_sale_end, flash_extra_discount fields
POST /api/bundles/admin can create bundle with flash sale fields
PUT /api/bundles/admin/{id} can clear flash sale by setting null values
Flash sale with percentage extra discount calculates correctly

backend_flash_edge_cases.test: Expired flash sales are not returned by /api/bundles/flash-sales

Flash bundle link in banner navigates to bundle detail
